label: Locked before any v0.1.28 simulation or place-and-route. Power is needs real board. v0.1.19 through v0.1.27 RTL stay byte-identical. Seed 9 and seed 13 are not regenerated and are not used to choose the percent.
handoff: The new module's replay end-of-frame beat must not take in_event, in_elem, or in_code from the host pins. The next frame's token is already presented while in_ready is low. scp4d_hybrid_n.v is not edited. A direct regression drives a synthetic switch-heavy trace into scp4d_hybrid_n and scp4d_hybrid_fix. The old module's decision set must differ from the golden. The new module's set must match. The trace is not seed 9 and not seed 13.

training.rng: mulberry32((seed * 10007 + addrW) >>> 0), then the same shuffle and code update as fixtures/scp/v0127-prereg.json.
training.note: New seed. Disjoint from v0.1.26 training seed 4, v0.1.27 training seed 11, held-out seed 9, and held-out seed 13.

selector_procedure.feature: event count of the completed frame
selector_procedure.percent_rule: Run scp4d_hybrid_fix on training seed 17 at ADDR_W 8, 10 and 12 once for each percent in percent_grid. A percent is legal only if all three runs are bit-exact against the golden model that uses the same percent, and each ADDR_W uses at least one pipelined-K1 frame and at least one N=4 frame. Among legal percents, choose the smallest sum of those three cycle counts. A tie takes the smaller percent. If no percent is legal, next_fsd is 0.
selector_procedure.engine_timing: The first frame starts on pipelined K1. The event count of a completed frame chooses the engine of the next frame. The golden model uses that same delay.
selector_procedure.tie: A tie on the training cycle sum takes the smaller percent.
selector_procedure.fail: If the synthetic regression is not bit-exact, stop before training. If no percent is legal, freeze next_fsd = 0. After the freeze, place once and run each held-out workload once. Do not change the percent. Do not regenerate seed 9 or seed 13. If a held-out decision set differs, or the wall time is not strictly under both baselines at ADDR_W 8, 10 and 12 on both workloads, report the numbers and stop.
selector_procedure.wall: held-out cycles / the fixed hybrid's own five-seed 45F median Fmax
selector_procedure.freeze: After the training runs and before either held-out run, write fixtures/scp/v0128-freeze.json with the chosen percent and this hash. Do not edit this pre-registration to chase a held-out number.

hybrid_success.workloads: Both held-out seed 9 and held-out seed 13, at ADDR_W 8, 10 and 12.
hybrid_success.bit_exact_PASS: The decision-change set matches the golden for the engine that frame used. Zero dropped records and zero extra records.
hybrid_success.both_engines: Where the frozen percent assigns both engines on that workload's completed-frame event counts, the run uses each engine for at least one frame. Report frame counts and switches either way.
hybrid_success.wall_PASS: Hybrid wall time strictly under pipelined K1 and strictly under the pure N=4 loop, at every required width, on both workloads.
hybrid_success.fit_PASS: All five 45F seeds of loop-hnfix-w4l8 route within 7200 s. 12F and 25F placement is reported and is not required to pass.

fit.flags: OSS CAD Suite 20261118, Yosys 0.71+50 583f380c6, nextpnr-ecp5 0.11.1-103-ge811ba48, router2, seeds 1-5, --45k CABGA381, --freq 12, --timing-allow-fail. Serial. No parallel nextpnr.

per_lut_expectation: The loop contains the codec. Decisions/s per LUT is expected to lose to standalone full scan (71397.91807427029). The v0.1.21 sweep stays FAIL unless a measured number exceeds that standalone figure.

verdict.PASS: Both held-out workloads are bit-exact, wall_PASS holds at ADDR_W 8, 10 and 12, both_engines holds where the frozen rule assigns both, and five 45F seeds route.
verdict.STOP: The frozen hybrid is bit-exact but the wall time is not strictly under both baselines. Report the best numbers. Do not change the percent.
verdict.FAIL: A held-out decision set does not match, or fewer than five 45F seeds route.

stop: One freeze. One held-out run of each workload. No retune. No regeneration of either held-out set.
